# ponte_mcp_server (Resource)

A registered MCP server. Policies can refuse servers that are not registered. Destroy deregisters the server and deletes its pinned tool definitions, proxy configuration and sync credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ponte_mcp_server" "crm" {
  name                = "CRM"
  endpoint_url        = "https://mcp.example.com/crm"
  data_classification = "confidential"
  environment         = "production"
  owner               = "crm-platform@example.com"
  require_tool_review = true # a newly seen tool is denied until an operator approves it
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_url` (String) https URL (http only for localhost). One registration per endpoint. Changing it replaces the resource: pinned tools belong to the endpoint.
- `name` (String) 3 to 64 characters.

### Optional

- `data_classification` (String) public, internal, confidential, restricted or pii.
- `environment` (String)
- `owner` (String)
- `require_tool_review` (Boolean) true: a newly seen tool is denied until an operator approves it. false: a new tool is trusted on first use.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ponte_mcp_server.crm res_0123456789ab
```
